user.title: Log in to Albert Heijn
user.description:
1. Open this link in your browser, but **don't log in yet**:

{login_url}

2. Open Developer Tools first: **F12**, or right-click → **Inspect**. Click the **Network** tab and turn on "Preserve log" (checkbox top-left of that tab).
3. Now log in with your AH account.
4. After logging in, the page tries to redirect to an address starting with `appie://login-exit?code=...`. Your browser can't open that — that's expected. A row for it appears in the Network tab, usually red or marked "(failed)", starting with `login-exit`.
5. Right-click that row → **Copy** → **Copy URL**.
6. Paste that URL (or just the part after `code=`) below.

error.invalid_code: Could not find a login code in what you pasted. Paste the full `appie://login-exit?code=...` URL or just the code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not exchange the login code for an Albert Heijn session. The code may have expired — redo the login steps and paste a fresh code.

add_item.name: Add item
add_item.description: Adds an item to your Albert Heijn shopping list by name (free text) or an exact product ID.

checkout.name: Send to cart
checkout.description: Moves unchecked, product-linked items into an order in the AH app (free-text items are skipped).

clear_list.name: Clear shopping list
clear_list.description: Removes all items from your Albert Heijn shopping list.
